description: This file implements a fake timer and clock control system for testing purposes, including classes and functions to manipulate and simulate timers, date, performance, and other timing-related APIs within a JavaScript environment.

classes.name: ClockController
classes.description: A class that manages simulated clock time, timers, and synchronization with real time, allowing for controlled testing of time-dependent code.

methods.name: createClock
methods.description: Creates a new ClockController instance along with an API for timer and clock manipulation, based on the provided global object.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs fake timers and clock control into the global object, replacing native timing functions with simulated ones.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Injects the clock control system into the global object and starts the clock.
